|lore=Uses state-of-the-art digital processors. Although Luke had lost his hand, the Alliance could rebuild it. They had the technology. They could make it better, stronger, faster.
|game_text=Deploy on Luke. Adds 2 to power and immunity to attrition. While in battle at a battleground, you may exchange one card from your hand with any interrupt in your Lost Pile. Lost if Disarmed.
|errata_history=Versions of '''Bionic Hand (V)''' in [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): the “Final Revised Virtual Set 6” sheet “Virtual Set #6” (Players Committee; announced and tournament-legal 12 January 2004; PDF dated 12 January 2004), page 1, slip 4 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 19 June 2004; the Committee still hosts the same file as [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards6.pdf VirtualCards6.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org), announced on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20040415220046/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news page]: “Deploy on Luke. Adds 2 to power and immunity to attrition. While in battle at a battleground, you may exchange one card from your hand with any interrupt in your Lost Pile. Lost if Disarmed.” This is the earliest surviving slip: the first release sheet of 21 November 2003 is not preserved. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “6•4” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The updated sheet of 12 October 2004 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20050406053829/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%206.pdf Virtual Set 6.pdf], Internet Archive 6 April 2005; PDF dated 12 October 2004) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS6-04-Bionic_Hand-original-slip-2004-10-12.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Bionic Hand (V) (Virtual Set 6) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154341/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards6.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 4), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on Luke. Luke’s power and immunity to attrition are +2. During battle at a battleground, may exchange a card in hand with an Interrupt in Lost Pile. This device lost if Luke Disarmed.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
